literature_supported_context: hnRNP C is a position-dependent regulator of alternative exon inclusion and exclusion.
evidence_scope: Direct evidence for HNRNPC as a splicing regulator; not T-cell-specific and not evidence that this microexon is functional.

literature_supported_context: NLRC5 transcriptionally regulates MHC class I and associated antigen-presentation genes, a pathway central to CD8 T-cell recognition.
evidence_scope: Immune-pathway relevance; does not establish an intrinsic role for the detected NLRC5 microexon in activated CD8 T cells.

literature_supported_context: SF3b is an intrinsic U2 snRNP subcomplex involved in branch-point recognition and spliceosome assembly/activation.
evidence_scope: Complex-level splicing evidence; the cited review is not a direct functional test of this SF3B3 microexon.

literature_supported_context: STIM2 supports store-operated calcium signaling, cytokine production, and prolonged NFAT nuclear localization in activated T cells.
evidence_scope: Direct T-cell pathway evidence, largely from mouse genetic experiments; no direct microexon functional evidence.

literature_supported_context: MAP4K4 loss suppresses CD4 T-cell proliferation, activation, and cytokine production and alters MAPK/PKC-theta signaling.
evidence_scope: T-cell evidence is mainly CD4-focused; relevance to CD8 activation is plausible but not directly demonstrated here.

literature_supported_context: Filamin A is recruited to the T-cell/APC contact site and is required for PKC-theta-associated T-cell activation and IL-2/transcription-factor responses.
evidence_scope: Direct T-cell signaling/cytoskeletal evidence; not direct evidence for this FLNA microexon.

literature_supported_context: ROCK2 participates in human T-cell signaling and transcriptional programs, including STAT3-associated TH17/TFH regulation.
evidence_scope: Strong pathway relevance but this microexon had valid MicroExonator comparisons at only 2 of 7 activation timepoints, so temporal interpretation is limited.

literature_supported_context: NCOR1 shapes naive and effector CD4 T-cell transcriptional programs and contributes to activated T-cell survival and effector function.
evidence_scope: Direct T-cell evidence is CD4-focused; no direct evidence for this CD8 microexon.

literature_supported_context: Human ARHGEF1 deficiency impairs RhoA activity, actin regulation, and migration in lymphocytes, including T-cell blasts.
evidence_scope: Human lymphocyte evidence; does not show that the detected microexon itself controls migration.
